lastText: GQGCOMPTE RENDUHome19141915191619171918-5MANPOWER-5MUNITIONS+1ARMY MORALEXI.1918The Same Ending, LaterThe war is won and the departments come back, and it takes longer and costs more than it needed to because two headquarters spent the spring agreeing with each other in writing. Every reserve moved late, every counterattack mounted a week after the moment for it, every liaison officer riding between two staffs who each had the authority to say no.Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. Unity of command did not win the war. It shortened it, and the difference is measured in the only currency that has been counted here.Return to file
